name: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Ltd
title: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Ltd - 514448 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume grew ~16% but VAM costs roughly doubled, price hikes cover only 60-70% of raw-material inflation from May, and receivables stretched to ~150-160 days, so margin and working-capital risk sit ahead of any capacity-led growth.

utilisation.quote: Right now, we are operating about 65% of our capacity.

capex.quote: we have done almost 80% of brownfield expansions. And now within one or two quarters, it will be finished.

triggers.label: Receivables ~150-160 days, up from INR 125 cr to INR 160 cr
triggers.quote: the receivables have gone up from INR 125 crores to INR 160 crores, which makes our receivable days four and a half to five months.

triggers.label: VAM price ~INR 80 to INR 160-180
triggers.quote: it was earlier INR 80, INR 75 around right now it is running INR 160 – INR 180 around.

triggers.label: Price hikes cover 60-70% of RM rise
triggers.quote: Almost 60% - 70% (of) price rise (of raw material) we have taken. But from the 1st May

triggers.label: Volume guide 15-20%, no numbers given
triggers.quote: we are targeting that at least 15 % - 20% of volume growth

triggers.label: Q4 volume ~16%, FY26 volume 8%
triggers.quote: we delivered a strong performance with revenues growing by 18% y- o-y, led by a nearly 16% volume growth during Q4.
